title: Remus
summary: Raleigh names Remus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Remus, who with Romulus laied the foundation of Rome in the eight yeere of Ahaz. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIII, §. VII, sig. 345a
